# KylixAI

> Kylix understands the business before it builds the AI. It studies how work actually happens, finds where time, money and opportunities are being lost, and builds the right system with software, AI and human judgment where each belongs.

## Position

Business understanding is Kylix's primary advantage. Process engineering follows. AI-native execution is a means of building the appropriate system. Business first. Process second. Technology third.

## Services

- [Services: Diagnose, Build & Operate](https://kylixai.com/services): The commercial path from a free fit call through diagnosis, implementation and ongoing systems management.
- [Systems Opportunity Audit](https://kylixai.com/systems-opportunity-audit): A diagnostic engagement that maps how the business operates, identifies high-value opportunities and produces a prioritized Kylix Systems Roadmap. The audit investment is credited in full toward implementation; if no meaningful opportunity is identified, the audit is fully refunded; clients keep the roadmap if they do not proceed.
- [Build & Implementation](https://kylixai.com/build-and-implementation): Business systems design, implementation, integration, testing, deployment and documentation. Implementation is scoped and priced based on the opportunities identified during the Systems Opportunity Audit.
- [Systems Management](https://kylixai.com/systems-management): Ongoing operation and improvement of deployed business infrastructure, scoped around the systems Kylix operates and the monitoring, maintenance, optimization and support required.
